neighbours.label: the second half of a paired he/she pronoun: ' or'/' and' and ' she' in 'he or she', 'he and she', 'his or her'
fire: Each applicant must bring a photo ID, and he or she will be asked to sign the form.
Before the test, the doctor will explain the risks, and he or she may order more scans.
When a customer calls, he or she should be greeted within three rings.
Every employee must lock his or her computer before leaving the desk.
The winner of the raffle can collect his or her prize at the front desk.
If your child feels sick, he or she should stay home from school.
Once the buyer accepts the offer, he or she has ten days to arrange financing.
A good teacher knows that he or she cannot reach every student the same way.
quiet: Each applicant must bring a photo ID, and they will be asked to sign the form.
Before the test, the doctor will explain the risks and may order more scans.
When a customer calls, the agent should answer within three rings.
Every employee must lock the computer before leaving the desk.
The winner of the raffle can collect the prize or a voucher at the front desk.
If your child feels sick, keep them home from school or call the nurse.
Once the buyer accepts the offer, there are ten days to arrange financing or cancel.
A good teacher knows that no lesson can reach every student the same way.

notes: Card: ' or' x13 of top 32 ('He or she'). Probe: 'he or she' 0.56, 'He and she' 0.89 on ' she', 'tea or coffee' ~0.
